mechanism: PRIMARY reuses round18 domain second-point rule. SHARED independently checks each known eligible channel with its own published-domain range bound at the actual primary point, only after legacy full-sector eligibility fails. BOTH activates both, no other edits.
development: Same 52 fixed configurations and two rounding models; zero numeric parameter sweep.
selection: Eligible variants must complete/audit and strictly improve mean with p95<=REF in both development models. Select minimum mean of normalized mean virtual times across the two models, tie fewer new modules then lexical name. No fallback promotion after fresh validation.
adoption: Frozen selected variant must complete/audit, mean strictly lower and p95<=REF in all four fresh ordinary/outer model batches. Compare all four locked variants for mechanism evidence; keep every regression.
